 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Bhagwati Prasad Sharma
 On The 3 rd Of September, 2025
 Criminal Appeal No. 4871 of 2018
 Ramu Soni
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
 Appearance:
 Shri Rajendra Pratap Singh - Advocate for appellant.
 Shri Pramod Pandey - Ga for the respondent/State.
 Order

entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
This Criminal Appeal has been preferred by the appellant being aggrieved by the impugned judgment dated 21-12-2017 passed by the Special Judge, SC/ST( Prevention of Atrocities ) Act, 1989 District Chhatarpur in ST No. 122/2017 whereas the learned trial Court has framed charges under Sections 363, 366-A, 376(jha) of IPC, under Section 4 of POCSO Act, 2012 and under Section 3(2)(v)
of SC/ST Act upon the appellant.

entities.text: Special Judge, SC/ST( Prevention of Atrocities ) Act, 1989 District Chhatarpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Aggrieved by this order, the appellant has preferred this appeal against the impugned order on the ground that at the time of alleged commission of offence, he was in Luvkush Nagar Sub-jail District Chhatarpur from 04-07- 2017 to 14-07-2017 in Case No. 52/2017 and released on 14-07-2017 whereas the offence has been committed on 07-07-2017 hence, it cannot be possible for the appellant to commit such offence as at the time of committing offence, he was already lodged in jail.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:42280 2 CRA-4871-2018

As directed, learned counsel for the appellant informed that in ST No. 122/2017 where charges have been framed by passing the impugned order has already been disposed of by the learned Special Judge hence, this Criminal Appeal is rendered infructuous.
Accordingly, the appeal is dismissed having rendered infructuous.
(BHAGWATI PRASAD SHARMA) JUDGE PG Ramu Soni vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 3 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/175364259/
